findings.quote: Grand Hotel d’Angkor opened its doors in 1932
Opened in 1932 for society globetrotters eager to discover the marvels of Angkor Wat

claims.text: The hotel was built in French Art Deco style with local influences.

findings.quote: constructed in the finest French Art Deco style with local influences

claims.text: In 2019 the hotel underwent an extensive renovation that restored its rooms, suites and architectural features.

findings.quote: In 2019 the hotel underwent an extensive renovation, which saw its 119 rooms and suites and other architectural features restored to their former glory.

claims.text: The hotel is in the Old French Quarter of Siem Reap, facing the Royal Palace and close to the Angkor National Museum.

findings.quote: Grand Hotel d'Angkor's location in the leafy Old French Quarter of Siem Reap, facing the Royal Palace and close to the Angkor National Museum

claims.text: The new Siem Reap International Airport is 48 km from the hotel.

findings.quote: the new Siem Reap International Airport is 48 km away

claims.text: Every stay is accompanied by a personal butler.

findings.quote: Every stay at Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor is accompanied by a personal butler.

claims.text: Herbs and spices for Restaurant 1932 are gathered daily in the hotel gardens.

findings.quote: The fragrant herbs and spices are gathered daily in the hotel gardens

claims.text: Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory with a resident pianist.

findings.quote: Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory with a resident pianist

claims.text: The hotel describes Elephant Bar cocktail hour as a Siem Reap institution.

findings.quote: Elephant Bar cocktail hour is a Siem Reap institution

claims.text: Raffles Spa offers authentic Khmer massages alongside modern treatments.

findings.quote: Our menu features authentic Khmer massages alongside modern treatments to soothe the senses.

claims.text: The hotel has two professional tennis courts with a resident coach.

findings.quote: Two professional courts with racquets and balls available to hire, and a resident coach for lessons.

claims.text: The original timber elevator in the lobby is described as the oldest lift in Indochina.

findings.quote: The original timber elevator in the lobby - the oldest lift in Indochina

claims.text: Following a Royal Guard tradition, the doormen wear silk pantaloons whose colour changes with the day of the week.

findings.quote: Following a Royal Guard tradition, our doormen wear silk pantaloons whose colour changes according to which day of the week it is.

claims.text: Restaurant 1932 offers four tasting menus conceived by Siem Reap native Chef Dorn Doeurt with Executive Chef Memo Hernandez.

findings.quote: four sensitively curated tasting menus, all of them conceived by Siem Reap native Chef Dorn Doeurt with Executive Chef Memo Hernandez

claims.text: The swimming pool was modelled after the ancient baths of Angkor.

findings.quote: Swim satisfying laps in the 35-metre swimming pool that was modelled after the ancient baths of Angkor.

claims.text: The hotel's events space hosts traditional Khmer dance performances every Saturday night.

findings.quote: Custom-built events space perfect for all occasions, hosting traditional Khmer dance performances every Saturday night.

claims.text: The hotel is in town rather than at the temples; the temples of Angkor are an 8 km ride away.

findings.quote: From here it is a short stroll or tuk tuk ride along the beautiful riverside to the town's colourful markets and an 8 km ride to the fabled temples of Angkor

claims.text: The hotel names November to February as the ideal time to visit, when the weather is cooler.

findings.quote: The ideal time is from November to February, when the weather is cooler and perfect for exploring the temples and local culture.

claims.text: Restaurant 1932 has a dress code; slip-ons and flip-flops are not permitted.

findings.quote: Dress code: smart elegant.
Slip-ons and flip-flops are not permitted.
